capabilities.name: PreProcessing.from_install
capabilities.description: Launch a local CFX-Pre session from the installed Ansys version.

capabilities.name: connect_to_cfx
capabilities.description: Attach to an existing PyCFX-MCP instance by IP address, port, and password, or server-information file.

capabilities.name: pre.setup.flow
capabilities.description: CFX-Pre flow-analysis collection, usually indexed by 'Flow Analysis 1'.

capabilities.name: flow.domain
capabilities.description: Domain collection under a flow analysis, usually indexed by domain name.

capabilities.name: domain.boundary
capabilities.description: Boundary collection for inlet, outlet, wall, opening, symmetry, and interface setup.

capabilities.name: boundary.boundary_conditions.mass_and_momentum
capabilities.description: Mass and momentum boundary-condition branch for speed, pressure, and flow regime.

capabilities.name: boundary.boundary_conditions.heat_transfer
capabilities.description: Thermal boundary-condition branch for adiabatic, fixed temperature, and heat flux walls.

capabilities.name: domain.fluid_models.heat_transfer_model.option
capabilities.description: Select Thermal Energy, Total Energy, or related heat-transfer model on a CFX domain.

capabilities.name: domain.fluid_definition.<fluid-definition-key>.material
capabilities.description: Set a material on an existing fluid_definition entry discovered in the active CFX domain.

capabilities.name: pre.setup.flow.Flow Analysis 1.domain.Default Domain.domain_models.reference_pressure.reference_pressure
capabilities.description: Set reference pressure on Flow Analysis 1 / Default Domain.

capabilities.name: pre.setup.flow.Flow Analysis 1.domain.Default Domain.fluid_models.heat_transfer_model.option
capabilities.description: Set the heat-transfer model on Flow Analysis 1 / Default Domain.

capabilities.name: pre.setup.flow.Flow Analysis 1.domain.Default Domain.fluid_models.turbulence_model.option
capabilities.description: Set the turbulence model on Flow Analysis 1 / Default Domain.

capabilities.name: pre.file.import_mesh
capabilities.description: Import a mesh file into CFX-Pre before creating domains and boundaries.

capabilities.name: pre.file.write_solver_input_file
capabilities.description: Write a CFX Solver input .def file from the current CFX-Pre setup.

capabilities.name: Solver.from_install
capabilities.description: Launch CFX Solver from an input .def file.

capabilities.name: solver.solution.start_run
capabilities.description: Start the CFX Solver run.

capabilities.name: solver.solution.wait_for_run
capabilities.description: Block until the CFX Solver run completes.

capabilities.name: solver.solution.get_results_file_name
capabilities.description: Return the .res results file produced by a solver run.

capabilities.name: PostProcessing.from_install
capabilities.description: Launch CFD-Post against a .res results file.

capabilities.name: post.results.contour
capabilities.description: CFD-Post contour collection for temperature, pressure, velocity, and other result plots.
